Belgrave's only win in the A.A.A. senior sprint relay championship came in 1954 when on July 31st at Birmingham the team of Dennis Merrett, Ron Holtum, Basil Walden and Ivan Mayers won their 4 x 110yds heat in 42.9 and then went on to take the final with the second best time recorded by a club team - 42.6.
